methods.title: NGMASTER:in silico multi-antigen sequence typing for Neisseria gonorrhoeae
methods.summary: Command-line tool that performs in silico NG-MAST typing on assembled Neisseria gonorrhoeae genomes.

methods.name: NGMLR
methods.title: Accurate detection of complex structural variations using single-molecule sequencing
methods.summary: Long-read aligner that improves alignment sensitivity and precision in repeat-rich regions.

methods.name: ngsBriggs
methods.full_name: NGS-based Briggs ancient DNA damage model
methods.title: Revisiting the Briggs Ancient DNA Damage Model: A Fast Maximum Likelihood Method to Estimate Post-Mortem Damage
methods.summary: Fast maximum-likelihood estimation of the Briggs ancient DNA post-mortem damage model from sequencing reads.

methods.name: ngsTools
methods.title: ngsTools: methods for population genetics analyses from next-generation sequencing data
methods.summary: Programs for population genetic analyses that account for genotype uncertainty in NGS data.

methods.name: NICHE-seq
methods.title: Spatial reconstruction of immune niches by combining photoactivatable reporters and scRNA-seq
methods.summary: Photoactivatable reporters mark cells within an intact niche; labelled cells are profiled by scRNA-seq to reconstruct niche composition.

methods.name: NicheCompass
methods.title: Quantitative characterization of cell niches in spatially resolved omics data
methods.summary: Graph deep-learning method that models cell-cell communication to learn interpretable niche embeddings in spatial omics data.

methods.name: NicheCorr
methods.title: NicheCorr: Identifying Niche-Specific Differential Gene Co-Expression in Spatial Transcriptomics
methods.summary: Statistical procedure that finds cell-type-specific gene co-expression changes across spatial niches, with ligand-receptor inference, for spatial transcriptomics.

methods.name: Nichefinder
methods.title: Spatially resolved multiomics of human meningeal development reveal lineage and disease dynamics
methods.summary: Computational tool for spatial label transfer and proximity analysis of spatial transcriptomics data from the human meninges atlas.

methods.name: Nicheformer
methods.title: Nicheformer: a foundation model for single-cell and spatial omics
methods.summary: Transformer foundation model pretrained on dissociated and spatial single-cell transcriptomics.

methods.name: NicheNet
methods.title: NicheNet: modeling intercellular communication by linking ligands to target genes
methods.summary: Predicts which ligands from sender cells drive expression changes in receiver cells by linking ligands to target genes through prior-knowledge networks.

methods.name: NNoVAE
methods.title: High-resolution species assignment of Anopheles mosquitoes using k-mer distances on targeted sequences.
methods.summary: Hierarchical species assignment of Anopheles from k-mer profiles of targeted amplicon panel sequences, combining nearest-neighbour and variational-autoencoder steps.

methods.name: NOMe-seq
methods.title: Genome-wide mapping of nucleosome positioning and DNA methylation within individual DNA molecules
methods.summary: GpC methyltransferase footprints accessible DNA, then bisulfite sequencing reads accessibility and endogenous CpG methylation together.

methods.name: Normalized Ribo-Seq
methods.title: Normalized Ribo-Seq for Quantifying Absolute Global and Specific Changes in Translation
methods.summary: Ribo-seq with a yeast-lysate spike-in added to mammalian lysates so that absolute, not only relative, ribosome density changes can be measured.

methods.name: Nova-ST
methods.title: Nova-ST: Nano-patterned ultra-dense platform for spatial transcriptomics
methods.summary: Low-cost, ultra-dense spatial transcriptomics array made from randomly barcoded Illumina flow cells.

methods.name: NovaClone
methods.title: NovaClone: A Network-Based Algorithm for Clonal and Subclonal Genotyping of Barcoded Transgene Integrations
methods.summary: Network-based algorithm for hierarchical clone and subclone calling from barcoded transgene integrations in single-cell lineage tracing.

methods.name: NovelSeq
methods.title: Detection and characterization of novel sequence insertions using paired-end next-generation sequencing
methods.summary: Computational framework to discover content and location of long novel sequence insertions from paired-end sequencing.

methods.name: nP-TRAP
methods.full_name: Nascent P-stalk-mediated translating ribosome affinity purification
methods.title: Simultaneous measurement of nascent transcriptome and translatome using 4-thiouridine metabolic RNA labeling and translating ribosome affinity purification.
methods.summary: 4sU labelling combined with P-stalk antibody ribosome affinity purification, measuring nascent RNA synthesis and translation of the same genes.

methods.name: NTT-seq
methods.title: Nanobody-tethered transposition enables multifactorial chromatin profiling at single-cell resolution
methods.summary: Nanobody-tethered Tn5 that binds primary antibodies against several histone marks or DNA-binding proteins, mapping multiple chromatin features in one assay, in bulk or single cells.

methods.name: NTVE
methods.title: Non-destructive transcriptomics via vesicular export
methods.summary: Live-cell method that packages stabilised RNA reporter barcodes and endogenous transcripts into virus-like particles for repeated sequencing of RNA expression over time.

methods.name: nucCAGE
methods.title: Mapping active cis-regulatory elements from transcription initiation events
methods.summary: Transcription start site assay for capped RNAs from nuclei, sensitive to low-abundance and unstable enhancer RNAs.

methods.name: Nucleotide Transformer
methods.title: Nucleotide Transformer: building and evaluating robust foundation models for human genomics.
methods.summary: Family of DNA foundation transformers (50 million to 2.5 billion parameters) pre-trained on human and other genomes and fine-tuned for molecular phenotype prediction.

methods.name: Nucleus hashing
methods.title: Nuclei multiplexing with barcoded antibodies for single-nucleus genomics
methods.summary: Labels nuclei from each sample with sample-barcoded antibodies so samples can be pooled and then demultiplexed in snRNA-seq.

methods.name: NvwaCE
methods.title: Modeling the vertebrate regulatory sequence landscape by UUATAC-seq and deep learning
methods.summary: Deep-learning model that predicts cCRE landscapes and regulatory grammar from genomic sequence, trained on UUATAC-seq and other vertebrate data.

methods.name: Oarfish
methods.title: Oarfish: enhanced probabilistic modeling leads to improved accuracy in long read transcriptome quantification
methods.summary: Probabilistic quantification of full-length transcripts from long-read RNA sequencing.

methods.name: Oatk
methods.title: Oatk: a de novo assembly tool for complex plant organelle genomes
methods.summary: De novo assembly tool for complex plant organelle genomes using a syncmer-based assembly graph and profile-HMM organelle identification.

methods.name: oFlowSeq
methods.title: oFlowSeq: a quantitative approach to identify protein coding mutations affecting cell type enrichment using mosaic CRISPR-Cas9 edited cerebral organoids
methods.summary: CRISPR-edited mosaic cerebral organoids are FACS-sorted by cell-type marker and the edited alleles sequenced to measure genotype-to-cell-type enrichment.

methods.name: OG-seq
methods.title: Sequencing the mouse genome for the oxidatively modified base 8-oxo-7,8-dihydroguanine by OG-Seq
methods.summary: Selective chemical biotinylation of 8-oxoG and pull-down maps oxidative lesions across the genome at low resolution.

methods.name: OGG1-AP-seq
methods.title: Genomic landscape of oxidative DNA damage and repair reveals regioselective protection from mutagenesis
methods.summary: OGG1 converts 8-oxoG to abasic sites that are biotinylated and enriched to map oxidative damage and its repair.

methods.name: Ohana
methods.title: Fast admixture analysis and population tree estimation for SNP and NGS data
methods.summary: Maximum-likelihood admixture (STRUCTURE-style, including genotype-likelihood NGS input) and population tree estimation from ancestry components.

methods.name: OK-seq
methods.title: Replication landscape of the human genome
methods.summary: Sequencing of purified Okazaki fragments to quantify replication fork directionality and delineate initiation and termination zones genome-wide.

methods.name: OKseqHMM
methods.title: OKseqHMM: a genome-wide replication fork directionality analysis toolkit
methods.summary: Toolkit that calls genome-wide replication fork directionality, origins and terminations from Okazaki-fragment sequencing and related datasets.

methods.name: Oligo-CALL
methods.full_name: Oligonucleotide-inducible CRISPR transcriptional activator-Assisted Lineage Labeling
methods.title: Oligo-CALL: A next-generation barcoding platform for studying resistance to targeted therapy
methods.summary: Oligonucleotide-induced CRISPR activation writes lineage barcodes that are linked to single-cell transcriptomes for clone tracking.

methods.name: OligoFISSEQ
methods.title: 3D mapping and accelerated super-resolution imaging of the human genome using in situ sequencing
methods.summary: Fluorescence in situ sequencing of barcoded Oligopaint probes to image many targeted genomic regions and trace chromosome 3D paths.

methods.name: OligoSeq
methods.title: OligoSeq: Rapid nanopore-sequencing of single-stranded oligonucleotides
methods.summary: Nanopore workflow that combines AmpliSeq and RevSeq to sequence single-stranded DNA oligonucleotides and resolve their reference sequence from basecall frequencies.

methods.name: Oligotyping
methods.title: Oligotyping: Differentiating between closely related microbial taxa using 16S rRNA gene data
methods.summary: Supervised computational method that resolves closely related bacterial organisms within 16S rRNA amplicon operational taxonomic units.

methods.name: OliTag-seq
methods.title: OliTag-seq enhances in cellulo detection of CRISPR-Cas9 off-targets
methods.summary: In-cell CRISPR-Cas9 off-target detection that tags breaks with a stable oligonucleotide and uses triple-priming amplification for higher sensitivity than GUIDE-seq.

methods.name: OmicsResonance
methods.title: OmicsResonance: An LLM-assisted cloud ecosystem for interactive and reproducible single-cell transcriptomic analysis
methods.summary: Browser-based, code-free platform for scRNA-seq processing with LLM-assisted annotation and pseudotime, CNV and virtual knockout modules.

methods.name: Omni-ATAC
methods.title: An improved ATAC-seq protocol reduces background and enables interrogation of frozen tissues
methods.summary: Optimised ATAC-seq protocol with lower background that also works on archival frozen tissue and 50 um sections.

methods.name: OmniRE-seq
methods.title: OmniRE-seq: A Dual-Method Framework for Decoding RNA Editing Dynamics in Disease and Therapy
methods.summary: Computational framework for bulk (RE-seq) and single-cell (scRE-seq) quantification, differential analysis and annotation of RNA editing.

methods.name: OnClass
methods.title: Leveraging the Cell Ontology to classify unseen cell types
methods.summary: Algorithm that classifies cells into Cell Ontology terms, including cell types absent from the training data.

methods.name: Onco-GPS
methods.title: Decomposing Oncogenic Transcriptional Signatures to Generate Maps of Divergent Cellular States
methods.summary: Data-driven framework that places tumour samples with shared oncogenic alterations onto a reference map of cellular states defined by transcriptional activity.

methods.name: OncoGAN
methods.title: In silico generation of synthetic cancer genomes using generative AI
methods.summary: Generative model combining adversarial networks and variational autoencoders that creates synthetic cancer genomes for benchmarking.

methods.name: OncoGEMINI
methods.title: OncoGEMINI: software for investigating tumor variants from multiple biopsies with integrated cancer annotations
methods.summary: Searchable database and filter tool for somatic and inherited variants across longitudinal tumour biopsies.

methods.name: OncoNPC
methods.title: Machine learning for genetics-based classification and treatment response prediction in cancer of unknown primary.
methods.summary: Machine-learning classifier that predicts primary cancer type from targeted NGS tumour profiles, for cancer of unknown primary.

methods.name: OneCell CUT&Tag
methods.title: Simultaneous single-cell profiling of chromatin, transcriptome and surface markers with OneCell CUT&Tag captures epigenomic reprogramming
methods.summary: Single-cell CUT&Tag that reads chromatin marks, the full transcriptome and surface markers from the same cell, down to one-cell input.

methods.name: online iNMF
methods.title: Iterative single-cell multi-omic integration using online learning
methods.summary: Online integrative NMF for integrating large, continually arriving single-cell multi-omic datasets at fixed memory.

methods.name: ONT-LibQC
methods.title: ONT-LibQC: rapid quality control of chromatin assay libraries using shallow nanopore sequencing
methods.summary: Shallow Oxford Nanopore sequencing (a few thousand reads) to QC CUT&RUN and Micro-C libraries for adapters, fragment sizes and biological enrichment before deep sequencing.

methods.name: OP-style Strand-seq
methods.title: Resource-efficient Strand-seq library preparation in microliter volumes: a one-pot-style adaptation for standard laboratory infrastructure
methods.summary: Microliter-volume, one-pot-style Strand-seq library prep with pooled MNase digestion and protease inactivation in standard well plates.

methods.name: Open-ST
methods.title: Open-ST: High-resolution spatial transcriptomics in 3D
methods.summary: Open-source sequencing-based spatial transcriptomics for 3D tissue profiling at subcellular resolution.

methods.name: OpenFISH
methods.title: OpenFISH enables same-section spatial transcriptomics and MALDI-MSI integration
methods.summary: Open-source, low-cost, modular FISH-based spatial transcriptomics workflow that is compatible with MALDI mass-spectrometry imaging on the same section.

methods.name: OPT
methods.title: Evidence of off-target probe binding affecting 10x Genomics Xenium gene panels compromise accuracy of spatial transcriptomic profiling
methods.summary: Software that flags Xenium gene-panel probes likely to bind off-target genes by aligning probe target sequences.

methods.name: OpTAG-seq
methods.title: Optical Cell Tagging for Spatially Resolved Single-Cell RNA Sequencing
methods.summary: Light-directed chemical tagging of cells at chosen positions within a multicellular sample, then scRNA-seq of the tagged cells to link position and transcriptome.

methods.name: Optical pooled screens
methods.title: Optical Pooled Screens in Human Cells
methods.summary: Pooled CRISPR screens read out by microscopy: guides are identified by in situ sequencing in each cell, linking perturbation to imaged phenotype.

methods.name: OPTIMuS PRIME-Del
methods.full_name: Optimal Paired-edits via T7 Insertions for Multiplexed Screening using PRIME-Del
methods.title: Multiplex programming of mappable, molecularly tagged genomic deletions
methods.summary: Paired prime editing that programs tagged intronic cCRE deletions while inserting a T7 promoter and barcode, enabling multiplexed deletion screens with optional single-cell RNA-seq readout.

methods.name: ORACLE-tRNAseq
methods.full_name: Optimized Reaction for Accurate Capture of Low-input Entities tRNA Sequencing
methods.title: Deciphering tRNA repertoires and translation coordination during mouse early embryogenesis by ORACLE-tRNAseq
methods.summary: Low-input tRNA sequencing method that profiles tRNA pools from as few as five mouse oocytes.

methods.name: ORCA
methods.title: Visualizing DNA folding and RNA in embryos at single-cell resolution
methods.summary: Sequential FISH tracing of chromatin folding at kilobase resolution combined with RNA readout in single cells.

methods.name: ORCHID
methods.title: An ONT sequencing framework for hantavirus genome assembly, variant analysis, and defective viral genome characterization from whole-segment amplicons
methods.summary: Bioinformatic pipeline for hantavirus genomes that performs reference-guided assembly, variant calling and defective viral genome classification from long-read amplicon data.

methods.name: ORI-Explorer
methods.title: ORI-Explorer: a unified cell-specific tool for origin of replication sites prediction by feature fusion
methods.summary: Feature-fusion AI model that predicts cell-specific origin-of-replication sites from DNA sequence and chromatin-state features.

methods.name: ORMAN
methods.full_name: Optimal Resolution of Multimapping Ambiguity of RNA-Seq Reads
methods.title: ORMAN: optimal resolution of ambiguous RNA-Seq multimappings in the presence of novel isoforms
methods.summary: Combinatorial optimisation method that assigns multimapping RNA-seq reads to the minimum set of transcript products per gene.

methods.name: OS-Seq
methods.title: Efficient targeted resequencing of human germline and cancer genomes by oligonucleotide-selective sequencing
methods.summary: Targeted resequencing where the sequencer's immobilised primer lawn captures target DNA and then primes sequencing, so capture and sequencing happen on the same surface.

methods.name: OT-knn
methods.title: OT-knn: A neighborhood-aware optimal transport framework for aligning spatial transcriptomics data
methods.summary: Optimal-transport method that aligns spatial transcriptomics slices using spatial k-nearest-neighbour context.

methods.name: Otari
methods.title: Variant-resolved prediction of context-specific isoform variation with a graph-based attention model
methods.summary: Attention-based graph neural network predicting tissue-specific isoform abundance and isoform-level variant effects from genome sequence and long-read transcriptomes.

methods.name: OTTER
methods.full_name: Orchestrated Transcriptomic, Tumor-xenograft (PDX/CDX), and Epigenomic Reporting Workflow
methods.title: OTTER: Orchestrated Transcriptomic, Tumor-xenograft (PDX/CDX), and Epigenomic Reporting Workflow
methods.summary: Compiled multi-omics workflow that removes murine host reads from xenograft sequencing, including a bisulfite-aware, strand-aware deconvolution engine.

methods.name: OttoSeq
methods.title: The one-week automated genome-wide optical pooled screen
methods.summary: Automated optical pooled screen that combines in situ sequencing of guide barcodes with cell painting imaging, completing a genome-wide knockout screen in eight days.

methods.name: outbreak.info
methods.title: Outbreak.info genomic reports: scalable and dynamic surveillance of SARS-CoV-2 variants and mutations
methods.summary: Web platform, pipelines and API for tracking SARS-CoV-2 lineages and mutations from sequence-derived data.

methods.name: OUTRIDER
methods.title: OUTRIDER: A Statistical Method for Detecting Aberrantly Expressed Genes in RNA Sequencing Data
methods.summary: Statistical method that detects aberrantly expressed genes (outliers) in RNA-seq data with automatic control for confounders.

methods.name: ovrlpy
methods.title: Identifying 3D signal overlaps in spatial transcriptomics data with ovrlpy
methods.summary: Computational tool that uses 3D transcript localisation to flag overlapping cells, tissue folds and bad segmentation in imaging-based spatial transcriptomics.

methods.name: Owl
methods.title: Hunting for microsatellite instability in long-read data with Owl.
methods.summary: Quantifies microsatellite instability genome-wide from PacBio long-read genomes using about 140,000 repeat markers.

methods.name: oxBS-Seq
methods.title: Quantitative sequencing of 5-methylcytosine and 5-hydroxymethylcytosine at single-base resolution
methods.summary: Selective chemical oxidation of 5hmC to 5fC before bisulfite conversion gives quantitative single-base maps of 5hmC.

methods.name: OxiDIP-seq
methods.title: Genome-wide mapping of 8-oxo-7,8-dihydro-2'-deoxyguanosine reveals accumulation of oxidatively-generated damage at DNA replication origins within transcribed long genes of mammalian cells
methods.summary: Anti-8-oxodG immunoprecipitation of fragmented DNA maps oxidative damage genome-wide.

methods.name: Pacasus
methods.title: Correcting palindromes in long reads after whole-genome amplification
methods.summary: Tool that corrects palindromic chimeric artefacts in long reads from whole-genome amplification.

methods.name: PACS
methods.title: Identification and genetic analysis of cancer cells with PCR-activated cell sorting
methods.summary: Droplet-based cell sorting that uses TaqMan PCR within single cells to trigger sorting, followed by analysis of the recovered DNA and RNA.

methods.name: PADD-seq
methods.title: Genome-wide mapping of protein-DNA damage interaction by PADD-seq
methods.summary: Runs Damage-seq on ChIP-enriched DNA to map where a protein sits relative to UV and cisplatin lesions at base resolution.

methods.name: Paired Hi-C
methods.chemistry: restriction-digest; proximity-ligation; tn5; droplet-microfluidics; facs-sorting; reverse-transcription
methods.title: Droplet Hi-C enables scalable, single-cell profiling of chromatin architecture in heterogeneous tissues
methods.summary: Droplet Hi-C adapted to the 10x Multiome kit to profile chromatin conformation and transcriptome from the same nucleus. Introduced in the Results section, not the abstract.

methods.name: Paired-Damage-seq
methods.title: Simultaneous single-cell DNA damage profiling and RNA sequencing by Paired-Damage-seq
methods.summary: Single-cell joint profiling of oxidative and single-stranded DNA damage with the transcriptome; damage sites are labelled by repair enzymes with biotinylated nucleotides, then cells are split-pool barcoded as in Paired-Tag.

methods.name: Paired-seq
methods.title: An ultra high-throughput method for single-cell joint analysis of open chromatin and transcriptome
methods.summary: Combinatorial-indexing joint profiling of chromatin accessibility and transcriptome in single nuclei.

methods.name: Paired-Tag
methods.title: Joint profiling of histone modifications and transcriptome in single cells from mouse brain
methods.summary: Antibody-guided Tn5 tagmentation plus combinatorial indexing for joint histone-mark and transcriptome profiles per nucleus.

methods.name: PAIso-seq
methods.title: Poly(A) inclusive RNA isoform sequencing (PAIso-seq) reveals wide-spread non-adenosine residues within RNA poly(A) tails
methods.summary: Full-length RNA isoform sequencing that also reads poly(A) tail length and non-adenosine residues within tails on PacBio.

methods.name: Palantir
methods.title: Characterization of cell fate probabilities in single-cell data with Palantir
methods.summary: Models differentiation as a Markov process on a diffusion-map graph to give pseudotime, differentiation potential and fate probabilities.

methods.name: PaleoHi-C
methods.title: Three-dimensional genome architecture persists in a 52,000-year-old woolly mammoth skin sample
methods.summary: Hi-C protocol adapted to ancient, permafrost-preserved tissue, capturing chromatin contacts from a 52,000-year-old mammoth sample.

methods.name: PALM-Seq
methods.title: Polyadenylation ligation-mediated sequencing (PALM-Seq) characterizes cell-free coding and non-coding RNAs in human biofluids
methods.summary: Ligation-based RNA-seq of cell-free RNA fragments from biofluids, with RNase H depletion of abundant RNAs.

methods.name: PALMO
methods.title: A comprehensive platform for analyzing longitudinal multi-omics data
methods.summary: Platform of five modules for analysing longitudinal bulk and single-cell multi-omics data, including variance decomposition and outlier detection.

methods.name: Pan-human Azimuth
methods.title: Organism-scale annotation with Pan-human Azimuth
methods.summary: Supervised neural network that maps human cells from many tissues and datasets onto one hierarchical annotation.

methods.name: Pan-Mod-seq
methods.title: Pan-modification profiling facilitates a cross-evolutionary dissection of the thermoregulated ribosomal epitranscriptome
methods.summary: Profiles 16 rRNA modifications in parallel across many samples, used to map modification dynamics across 14 species and growth conditions.

methods.name: Panacus
methods.title: Panacus: fast and exact pangenome growth and core size estimation
methods.summary: Fast, exact estimator of pangenome growth and core size from pangenome graphs.

methods.name: Panagram
methods.title: Panagram reveals pangenome architectures underlying trait variation in plants and animals
methods.summary: Alignment-free pangenome analysis framework that compares genomes by pan-k-mer profiles to link sequence variation to traits.

methods.name: Pandora
methods.title: Pandora: nucleotide-resolution bacterial pan-genomics with reference graphs
methods.summary: Pan-genome reference-graph tool for nucleotide-resolution variant detection and pan-genotyping across bacterial samples.

methods.name: panEDTA
methods.title: Differences in activity and stability drive transposable element variation in tropical and temperate maize
methods.summary: Optimized open-source algorithm for de novo transposable element annotation across pan-genomes.

methods.name: pangene
methods.title: Exploring gene content with pangene graphs
methods.summary: Tool that builds a gene graph across genomes to identify gene orientation, order and copy-number changes in pangenomes.

methods.name: Pangolin
methods.title: Predicting RNA splicing from DNA sequence using Pangolin.
methods.summary: Deep learning model that predicts splice site strength across tissues from DNA sequence and scores splicing effects of variants.

methods.name: PanGraph
methods.title: PanGraph: scalable bacterial pan-genome graph construction
methods.summary: Scalable pan-genome graph construction for bacterial collections, built from blocks of homologous sequence shared between genomes.

methods.name: PanPA
methods.title: PanPA: generation and alignment of panproteome graphs
methods.summary: Builds graphs from multiple sequence alignments of panproteome protein families and aligns DNA or amino acid sequences back to them.

methods.name: Panpipes
methods.title: Panpipes: a pipeline for multiomic single-cell and spatial transcriptomic data analysis
methods.summary: Workflow suite for multimodal single-cell and spatial transcriptomic QC, integration and reference mapping.

methods.name: PanTE
methods.title: PanTE: A Comprehensive Framework for Transposable Element Discovery in Graph-based Pangenomes
methods.summary: Framework to construct transposable-element libraries for single genomes and graph-based pangenomes.

methods.name: pantera
methods.title: Identification of transposable element families from pangenome polymorphisms
methods.summary: Builds transposable element family libraries from structural polymorphisms across pangenome assemblies.

methods.name: PantheonOS
methods.title: PantheonOS: An Evolvable Multi-Agent Framework for Automatic Genomics Discovery
methods.summary: Evolvable multi-agent LLM framework for automated single-cell and spatial genomics analysis, including agentic code evolution.

methods.name: PAQS-seq
methods.full_name: periodate-dependent analysis of queuosine and sulfur modification sequencing
methods.title: Analysis of queuosine and 2-thio tRNA modifications by high throughput sequencing
methods.summary: Periodate oxidation of queuosine leaves deletion signatures in RNA-seq, also revealing 2-thio tRNA modifications.

methods.name: PAR-CLIP
methods.title: Transcriptome-wide identification of RNA-binding protein and microRNA target sites by PAR-CLIP
methods.summary: Cell-based crosslinking with 4-thiouridine so that crosslink sites appear as T-to-C transitions in cDNA, mapping RBP and miRNP binding sites transcriptome-wide.

methods.name: Paragraph
methods.title: Paragraph: a graph-based structural variant genotyper for short-read sequence data
methods.summary: Graph-based structural-variant genotyper for short-read data that models SVs with sequence graphs and SV annotations.

methods.name: PARE
methods.title: Global identification of microRNA-target RNA pairs by parallel analysis of RNA ends
methods.summary: Sequencing of the 5' ends of polyadenylated, uncapped mRNA decay products to identify miRNA-directed cleavage sites and target RNAs transcriptome-wide.

methods.name: PARIS
methods.full_name: Psoralen Analysis of RNA Interactions and Structures
methods.title: RNA Duplex Map in Living Cells Reveals Higher-Order Transcriptome Structure
methods.summary: Reversible psoralen crosslinking and proximity ligation to map RNA duplexes transcriptome-wide in living cells.

methods.name: PARIS2
methods.full_name: Psoralen Analysis of RNA Interactions and Structures
methods.title: Optimized photochemistry enables efficient analysis of dynamic RNA structuromes and interactomes in genetic and infectious diseases
methods.summary: Optimised psoralen crosslinking and proximity ligation that maps RNA duplexes and interactions in living cells with far higher efficiency than PARIS.

methods.name: Parliament2
methods.title: Parliament2: Accurate structural variant calling at scale
methods.summary: Consensus structural-variant framework that combines multiple SV callers on short-read data, optimised for parallel, low-cost runs.

methods.name: parmigiano
methods.title: An empirical Bayes framework for burden and dispersion association tests helps prioritize rare variants associated with Alzheimer’s disease
methods.summary: Empirical Bayes framework that learns functional-annotation weights for existing rare-variant association tests to prioritise variants in coding and noncoding regions.

methods.name: PARS
methods.title: Genome-wide measurement of RNA secondary structure in yeast
methods.summary: Deep sequencing of RNA fragments cut by structure-specific enzymes to profile secondary structure of thousands of transcripts at single-nucleotide resolution.

methods.name: Parse Biosciences Evercode
methods.summary: Instrument-free split-pool combinatorial barcoding kits for single-cell or single-nucleus whole-transcriptome profiling of fixed samples, scaling to 1 million cells and 384 samples.

methods.name: PaSCient
methods.title: Learning multi-cellular representations of single-cell transcriptomics data enables characterization of patient-level disease states
methods.summary: Machine-learning model producing patient-level representations from multi-cellular scRNA-seq.

methods.name: PASTE2
methods.title: Partial alignment of multislice spatially resolved transcriptomics data
methods.summary: Partial alignment and 3D reconstruction of multislice spatial transcriptomics data.

methods.name: PASTRI
methods.full_name: Probabilistic Algorithm for Somatic Tree Inference
methods.title: Tumor phylogeny inference using tree-constrained importance sampling
methods.summary: Infers clones and a tumour phylogenetic tree from bulk tumour sequencing data using tree-constrained importance sampling.

methods.name: PAT-seq
methods.title: PAT-seq: a method to study the integration of 3'-UTR dynamics with gene expression in the eukaryotic transcriptome
methods.summary: Targeted 3-prime sequencing of polyadenylated RNA that includes the full native poly(A) tail to report expression, polyadenylation sites and adenylation state.

methods.name: Patch-seq
methods.title: Integration of electrophysiological recordings with single-cell RNA-seq data identifies neuronal subtypes
methods.summary: Whole-cell patch-clamp recording followed by aspiration of the cell contents for full-transcriptome single-cell RNA-seq, linking electrophysiology to molecular identity.

methods.name: PATH
methods.title: Defining heritability, plasticity, and transition dynamics of cellular phenotypes in somatic evolution
methods.summary: Phylogenetic framework that quantifies heritability versus plasticity of cell states and transition dynamics from single-cell lineage tracing.

methods.name: PathFA
methods.title: Probabilistic pathway-based multimodal factor analysis.
methods.summary: Bayesian factor analysis over pathways that integrates multimodal profiling data from small cohorts into interpretable pathway-level factors.

methods.name: Patho-DBiT
methods.title: Spatially exploring RNA biology in archival formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded tissues
methods.summary: Pathology-compatible spatial whole-transcriptome sequencing of FFPE tissue sections using in situ polyadenylation and DBiT barcoding.

methods.name: PathoBERT
methods.title: PathoBERT: A Hybrid Attention-Based Genomic Language Model for Read-Level Bacterial Pathogenicity Prediction
methods.summary: Hybrid DNABERT-based genomic language model that classifies individual bacterial sequencing reads as pathogenic or not and aggregates reads to genome-level calls.

methods.name: PathOS
methods.title: PathOS: a decision support system for reporting high throughput sequencing of cancers in clinical diagnostic laboratories.
methods.summary: Web-based decision support system that takes variant data through to a clinical report for high-throughput sequencing of cancers.

methods.name: PatHoST
methods.title: PatHoST: weakly supervised reconstruction of pathogen spatial distributions from host transcriptomes
methods.summary: Weakly supervised model that learns host transcriptional programs predictive of pathogen presence and reconstructs pathogen spatial distributions.

methods.name: Pattern-Filter
methods.title: Pattern-Filter structural validation of single-cell RNA-seq reads reduces artifactual barcodes and improves biological resolution
methods.summary: Preprocessing tool that removes scRNA-seq reads lacking expected anchor motifs and non-canonical barcode or UMI bases before alignment.

methods.name: PB-seq
methods.full_name: protein/DNA binding followed by high-throughput sequencing
methods.title: Accurate prediction of inducible transcription factor binding intensities in vivo
methods.summary: In vitro protein/DNA binding on naked genomic DNA followed by sequencing, mapping a transcription factor's binding energy landscape.

methods.name: PB10X

methods.summary: Plate-based scRNA-seq built on Smart-seq3xpress whose cDNA feeds standard 10x 5' gene-expression and V(D)J libraries, with indexed FACS sorting into 384-well plates.

methods.name: PBA
methods.journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
methods.title: Fundamental limits on dynamic inference from single-cell snapshots

methods.summary: Framework that integrates single-cell and spatial transcriptomes, somatic mutations and matched tumour and plasma DNA sequencing to model ctDNA release.

methods.name: scMCodes
methods.title: Epigenomic complexity of the human brain revealed by single-cell DNA methylomes and 3D genome structures
methods.summary: Predicts brain cell types from DNA methylation status at a small set of genomic sites.

methods.name: scMD
methods.title: scMD facilitates cell type deconvolution using single-cell DNA methylation references
methods.summary: Cellular deconvolution framework that builds DNA methylation signatures from single-cell methylation data to estimate cell-type fractions in bulk samples.

methods.name: scMeFormer
methods.title: Deep learning imputes DNA methylation states in single cells and enhances the detection of epigenetic alterations in schizophrenia.
methods.summary: Transformer model that imputes CpG methylation states in single nuclei from low-coverage snmC-seq-type data.

methods.name: scMGFGRN
methods.title: Multi-model biological and sequence information fusion for gene regulatory network inference from single-cell transcriptomics
methods.summary: Multi-model deep-learning framework for gene regulatory network inference from single-cell transcriptomes.

methods.name: scMicro-C
methods.title: Single-cell Micro-C profiles 3D genome structures at high resolution and characterizes multi-enhancer hubs
methods.summary: Single-cell Micro-C, an MNase-based 3D genome mapping method with about 5 kb resolution.

methods.name: scMitoMut
methods.title: scMitoMut for calling mitochondrial lineage-related mutations in single cells
methods.summary: R package with a beta-binomial model for calling mitochondrial lineage mutations from single-cell DNA, ATAC and multiome data.

methods.name: scMMGAN
methods.title: Single-cell multi-modal GAN reveals spatial patterns in single-cell data from triple-negative breast cancer
methods.summary: Adversarial framework that integrates single-cell data from multiple modalities into one unified representation.

methods.name: scMNase-seq
methods.title: Genome-wide profiling of nucleosome position and chromatin accessibility in single cells using scMNase-seq
methods.summary: MNase digests FACS-sorted single cells; sub-nucleosome fragments report accessibility and mononucleosome fragments report nucleosome positions.

methods.name: scMoMaT
methods.title: scMoMaT jointly performs single cell mosaic integration and multi-modal bio-marker detection
methods.summary: Matrix tri-factorization method for mosaic integration of single-cell multi-omics that also reports cluster-specific multi-modal bio-markers.

methods.name: scMOTIPh
methods.title: Intravital single-cell behavior profiling reveals disrupted germinal center B cell motility and interactions by EZH2 gain-of-function mutation
methods.summary: Computational framework integrating single-cell behavioural features from intravital imaging with transcriptomic profiles.

methods.name: scMPCDS
methods.journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
methods.title: Single-cell profiling of mitochondrial phenotyping-coupled mtDNA genotyping
methods.summary: Single-cell profiling that couples mtDNA mutation and heteroplasmy sequencing with per-cell mitochondrial membrane potential and reactive oxygen species.

methods.name: scMspJI-seq
methods.title: Strand-specific single-cell methylomics reveals distinct modes of DNA demethylation dynamics during early mammalian development
methods.summary: Single-cell method for strand-specific 5mC quantification using MspJI, used to resolve strand-asymmetric demethylation in early mouse and human embryos.

methods.name: scMT-seq
methods.title: Simultaneous profiling of transcriptome and DNA methylome from a single cell
methods.summary: The cytoplasm is separated from the nucleus; Smart-seq2 profiles RNA and bisulfite-based scRRBS profiles methylation from one cell.

methods.name: scMTR-seq
methods.title: Combinatorial profiling of multiple histone modifications and transcriptome in single cells using scMTR-seq
methods.summary: Single-cell method that profiles six histone modifications together with the transcriptome in the same cells.

methods.name: scNanoATAC-seq2
methods.full_name: Single-cell assay for transposase-accessible chromatin using long-read sequencing, version 2
methods.title: Chromatin accessibility landscape of mouse early embryos revealed by single-cell NanoATAC-seq2
methods.summary: Single-cell long-read ATAC-seq for scarce samples such as early embryos, resolving accessibility at repeats, paralogs and imprinted loci.

methods.name: scNanoHi-C
methods.title: scNanoHi-C: a single-cell long-read concatemer sequencing method to reveal high-order chromatin structures within individual cells
methods.summary: Single-cell Hi-C read on nanopore so whole ligation concatemers (multi-way contacts) are sequenced.

methods.name: scNanoHi-C2
methods.title: Single-cell long-read Hi-C, scNanoHi-C2, details 3D genome reorganization in embryonic-stage germ cells
methods.summary: Second-generation single-cell nanopore Hi-C that profiles 3D genome structure and multi-way contacts in individual cells from very small inputs.

methods.name: scNanoSeq-CUT&Tag
methods.title: scNanoSeq-CUT&Tag: a single-cell long-read CUT&Tag sequencing method for efficient chromatin modification profiling within individual cells
methods.summary: CUT&Tag adapted to nanopore long-read sequencing to profile histone marks and TF occupancy in single cells, including repeats and allele-specific signal.

methods.name: scNAT
methods.title: scNAT: a deep learning method for integrating paired single-cell RNA and T cell receptor sequencing profiles.
methods.summary: Deep learning model that jointly embeds paired scRNA-seq and scTCR-seq profiles in a unified latent space.

methods.name: ScNaUmi-seq
methods.title: High throughput error corrected Nanopore single cell transcriptome sequencing
methods.summary: Long-read single-cell transcriptome method combining Oxford Nanopore sequencing with cell barcode and UMI assignment for error-corrected full-length reads.

methods.name: scNMT-seq
methods.full_name: Single-cell nucleosome, methylation and transcription sequencing
methods.title: scNMT-seq enables joint profiling of chromatin accessibility DNA methylation and transcription in single cells
methods.summary: A GpC methyltransferase marks open chromatin before bisulfite conversion, and RNA is split off, giving accessibility, methylation and transcriptome from one cell.

methods.name: scNOMe-seq
methods.title: Simultaneous measurement of chromatin accessibility, DNA methylation, and nucleosome phasing in single cells
methods.summary: NOMe-seq adapted to single cells: a GpC methyltransferase marks accessible DNA, and bisulfite sequencing reads accessibility and methylation together.

methods.name: scNOVA
methods.title: Functional analysis of structural variants in single cells using Strand-seq
methods.summary: Haplotype-aware single-cell tool that links structural variants discovered from Strand-seq to gene expression inferred from nucleosome occupancy.

methods.name: scNovel
methods.title: scNovel: a scalable deep learning-based network for novel rare cell discovery in single-cell transcriptomics
methods.summary: Deep learning network that finds novel rare cell types in single-cell RNA-seq data without prior annotation.

methods.name: scNT-seq
methods.full_name: Single-cell metabolically labeled new RNA tagging sequencing
methods.title: Massively parallel and time-resolved RNA sequencing in single cells with scNT-seq
methods.summary: Droplet-based single-cell RNA-seq that chemically marks newly transcribed mRNA with T-to-C substitutions on barcoded beads to profile new and old transcriptomes together.

methods.name: SCODE
methods.title: SCODE: an efficient regulatory network inference algorithm from single-cell RNA-Seq during differentiation
methods.summary: Efficient algorithm that infers regulatory networks from single-cell RNA-seq during differentiation using ordinary differential equations.

methods.name: scOLAR
methods.title: scOLAR: Ontology-Anchored Open-Set Annotation of Single-Cell RNA-seq Data
methods.summary: Ontology-guided open-set annotation of scRNA-seq that flags novel cell populations absent from the reference.

methods.name: scONE-seq
methods.title: scONE-seq: A single-cell multi-omics method enables simultaneous dissection of phenotype and genotype heterogeneity from frozen tumors
methods.summary: One-tube single-cell whole-genome DNA and RNA amplification that works on frozen tumour samples.

methods.name: scooby
methods.title: scooby: modeling multimodal genomic profiles from DNA sequence at single-cell resolution
methods.summary: Sequence-to-profile model that predicts single-cell RNA coverage and ATAC insertion tracks using a cell-specific decoder on Borzoi.

methods.name: Scooby-2
methods.title: Scooby-2: fine-tuning AlphaGenome for single-cell genomic track prediction
methods.summary: Fine-tunes AlphaGenome with a cell-specific decoder to predict single-cell RNA-seq and chromatin-accessibility tracks from DNA sequence.

methods.name: SCOPE
methods.full_name: Spatial reConstruction via Oligonucleotide Proximity Encoding
methods.summary: Optics-free spatial reconstruction: relative positions of DNA-barcoded beads are inferred from sequenced chimeric molecules formed between diffusing sender and tethered receiver oligonucleotides.

methods.name: SCORE
methods.title: SCORE: Smart Consensus Of RNA Expression-a consensus tool for detecting differentially expressed genes in bacteria
methods.summary: Snakemake-based consensus workflow that combines several differential-expression tools for bacterial RNA-seq.

methods.name: SCORPIUS
methods.title: SCORPIUS improves trajectory inference and identifies novel modules in dendritic cell development
methods.summary: Trajectory inference method that orders single cells along a developmental path and identifies modules along it.

methods.name: SCOTIA
methods.full_name: spatially constrained optimal transport interaction analysis
methods.title: Spatially resolved analysis of pancreatic cancer identifies therapy-associated remodeling of the tumor microenvironment
methods.summary: Optimal-transport model of cell-cell ligand-receptor interactions using spatial distance and expression in spatial transcriptomics.

methods.name: scPAISO
methods.title: Identification and quantification of alternative polyadenylation sites in single cell RNA-seq data using scPAISO
methods.summary: Computational pipeline that uses Read1 of 3' tag scRNA-seq to identify polyadenylation sites and quantify PAS isoforms.

methods.name: scPCOR-seq
methods.full_name: single-cell Profiling of Chromatin Occupancy and RNAs Sequencing
methods.title: scPCOR-seq enables co-profiling of chromatin occupancy and RNAs in single cells
methods.summary: Single-cell method that profiles histone marks or RNA polymerase II binding together with RNA from the same cells.

methods.name: scPFA
methods.title: Lineage-informed factor analysis reveals heritable programs of single-cell gene expression
methods.summary: Phylogenetic factor analysis that models single-cell expression programs evolving along lineage trees.

methods.name: scPhere
methods.title: Deep generative model embedding of single-cell RNA-Seq profiles on hyperspheres and hyperbolic spaces
methods.summary: Deep generative model embedding scRNA-seq profiles on hyperspheres or hyperbolic space.

methods.name: scPipe
methods.title: scPipe: A flexible R/Bioconductor preprocessing pipeline for single-cell RNA-sequencing data
methods.summary: R/Bioconductor pipeline for scRNA-seq preprocessing: barcode demultiplexing, alignment, UMI-aware gene counting and QC across several protocols.

methods.name: scPloidyR
methods.title: Integrative Modeling of Read Depth and B-Allele Frequency Improves Single-Cell Copy Number Calling from Targeted DNA Sequencing Panels
methods.summary: Hidden Markov model that jointly models read depth and B-allele frequency to call single-cell copy number from targeted Tapestri panels.

methods.name: scPoli
methods.title: Population-level integration of single-cell datasets enables multi-scale analysis across samples
methods.summary: Open-world generative learner for population-level single-cell integration, label transfer and sample-level variation.

methods.name: scPower
methods.title: scPower accelerates and optimizes the design of multi-sample single cell transcriptomic studies
methods.summary: Statistical framework for design and power analysis of multi-sample single-cell transcriptomic experiments.

methods.name: scPRS
methods.title: Single-cell polygenic risk scores dissect cellular and molecular heterogeneity of complex human diseases
methods.summary: Graph neural network computing single-cell-resolved polygenic risk scores from reference scATAC-seq profiles.

methods.name: scPT-seq
methods.title: Direct detection of CRISPR mutations and transcriptional responses at single cell resolution  in vivo
methods.summary: Single-cell RNA assay that reads CRISPR-induced mutations at base-pair resolution alongside transcriptomes in vivo.

methods.name: scquantum
methods.title: Delineating the copy-number substructure of metastatic tumors with CopyKit
methods.summary: Companion method for estimating integer copy numbers from single-cell DNA copy-number data, introduced with CopyKit.

methods.name: SCRB-seq
methods.title: Characterization of directed differentiation by high-throughput single-cell RNA-Seq
methods.summary: Plate-based digital gene-expression scRNA-seq protocol that surveys mRNA from thousands of single cells.

methods.name: scRCAT-seq
methods.full_name: Single-cell RNA cap and tail sequencing
methods.title: Single-cell RNA cap and tail sequencing (scRCAT-seq) reveals subtype-specific isoforms differing in transcript demarcation
methods.summary: Short-read single-cell method that tags both transcript ends during a modified Smart-seq2 protocol, then tagments and captures the 5' or 3' ends to demarcate isoform boundaries.

methods.name: scReMeMber-Seq
methods.title: Joint recording of past and present transcriptomes reconstructs single-cell trajectories
methods.summary: Methylation-based cell-memory recorder: pulse-induced DCM-Polr2b marks past transcription in DNA methylation, read out with scMT-seq alongside the present transcriptome.

methods.name: scRep
methods.title: scRep: A Latent-Space Self-Distilled Foundation Model for Single-Cell Representation Learning
methods.summary: Latent-space self-distillation foundation model for scRNA-seq representation learning.

methods.name: scRepli-seq
methods.title: Single-cell replication profiling to measure stochastic variation in mammalian replication timing.
methods.summary: Measures replication timing in single mouse embryonic stem cells from DNA copy number of individually sorted S-phase nuclei.

methods.name: scRhythmBayes
methods.title: Decoding Cell-level Circadian Phase and Rhythm-state Remodeling in Single-cell Transcriptomes With scRhythmBayes
methods.summary: Probabilistic algorithm that infers cell-level circadian phase and gene-level rhythm-state changes from single-cell transcriptomes.

methods.name: Scriabin
methods.title: Comparative analysis of cell-cell communication at single-cell resolution
methods.summary: Infers cell-cell communication at single-cell resolution without cell aggregation or downsampling, enabling comparative communication networks across conditions and timepoints from scRNA-seq.

methods.name: scRIPT
methods.full_name: single-cell Rapid Integrated Platform for Tracing
methods.title: scRIPT: a rapid, high-coverage single-cell lineage-tracing method applied to the hematoendothelial differentiation of embryonic stem cells
methods.summary: Rapid RNP-based CRISPR barcoding with fluorescent reporter insertion, sorting of informative cells and short-read library prep for clonal and transcriptome readouts.

methods.name: scROSHI
methods.full_name: robust supervised hierarchical identification of single cells
methods.title: scROSHI: robust supervised hierarchical identification of single cells.
methods.summary: Training-free hierarchical cell-type classifier that assigns single cells to cell types using previously curated cell-type marker gene lists.

methods.name: scRR-seq
methods.title: scRepli-RamDA-seq: a multi-omics technology enabling the analysis of gene expression dynamics during S-phase
methods.summary: Single-cell multi-omics giving DNA replication profiles and full-length total RNA from the same cell, haplotype-specific.

methods.name: scRRBS
methods.title: Single-cell methylome landscapes of mouse embryonic stem cells and early embryos analyzed using reduced representation bisulfite sequencing
methods.summary: Reduced representation bisulfite sequencing applied to single cells, enriching CpG-rich regions for a single-cell methylome.

methods.name: Scrublet
methods.title: Scrublet: Computational Identification of Cell Doublets in Single-Cell Transcriptomic Data
methods.summary: Detects doublets by scoring each cell against simulated doublets in a nearest-neighbour graph.

methods.name: scSeqComm
methods.title: Identify, quantify and characterize cellular communication from single-cell RNA sequencing data with scSeqComm
methods.summary: Quantifies intercellular and intracellular signalling evidence from scRNA-seq, combining ligand-receptor and downstream target-gene expression.

methods.name: scSLAM-seq
methods.full_name: Single-cell thiol(SH)-linked alkylation of RNA for metabolic labelling sequencing
methods.title: scSLAM-seq reveals core features of transcription dynamics in single cells
methods.summary: Single-cell SLAM-seq that uses thiol alkylation of 4sU-labeled RNA to separate new from old transcripts in each cell.

methods.name: scSLIDE
methods.title: Reconstructing developmental and disease progression with sample-level embeddings
methods.summary: Framework of sample-level embeddings of single-cell data for reconstructing developmental and disease progression across samples.

methods.name: scSNV-seq
methods.full_name: single-cell genotyping and transcriptomics of single nucleotide variants
methods.title: scSNV-seq: high-throughput phenotyping of single nucleotide variants by coupled single-cell genotyping and transcriptomics
methods.summary: Couples single-cell genotyping of SNVs with transcriptomics in the same cells, so CRISPR-screen phenotypes are assigned to exact variants.

methods.name: scSPLAT
methods.title: scSPLAT, a scalable plate-based protocol for single cell WGBS library preparation
methods.summary: Plate-based, pooled single-cell whole-genome bisulfite library preparation using splinted ligation adapter tagging.

methods.name: scSPRITE
methods.full_name: Single-cell split-pool recognition of interactions by tag extension
methods.title: Single-cell measurement of higher-order 3D genome organization with scSPRITE
methods.summary: Split-pool barcoding of crosslinked DNA within single nuclei to map multiway 3D genome contacts.

methods.name: SCST
methods.title: Constructing the spatiotemporal atlas of single-cell lineage trajectories in stereotypic biological structures
methods.summary: Single-cell resolved spatiotemporal mapping that integrates spatial transcriptomics with scRNA-seq to place single cells in a developmental atlas.

methods.name: scStripe
methods.title: Regulatory-scale stripe analysis from single-cell Hi-C with scStripe
methods.summary: Imputation-free statistical framework for detecting chromatin stripes in sparse single-cell Hi-C maps.

methods.name: scTab
methods.title: scTab: Scaling cross-tissue single-cell annotation models
methods.summary: Tabular neural-network model for automated cell-type annotation of scRNA-seq data across tissues.

methods.name: scTACL
methods.title: scTACL: a multitask topology-aware contrastive learning approach for single-cell transcriptomics analysis
methods.summary: Contrastive-learning model that aligns a cell similarity graph with an embedding graph under a ZINB decoder, for imputation, clustering, batch correction and cell-cell interaction in scRNA-seq.

methods.name: scTaILoR-seq
methods.title: Single-cell long-read targeted sequencing reveals transcriptional variation in ovarian cancer
methods.summary: Single-cell long-read isoform sequencing with hybridization capture of over a thousand genes, enabling isoform, SNV and allele-imbalance analysis in ovarian cancer.

methods.name: scTAM-seq
methods.title: scTAM-seq enables targeted high-confidence analysis of DNA methylation in single cells
methods.summary: Targeted, bisulfite-free single-cell DNA methylation assay for up to 650 CpGs in up to 10,000 cells, also querying surface protein and somatic mutations.

methods.name: scTAPS
methods.title: Direct and bisulfite-free 5-methylcytosine and 5-hydroxymethylcytosine sequencing at single-cell resolution with scTAPS and scCAPS +
methods.summary: Bisulfite-free, plate-based single-cell sequencing of 5mC and 5hmC at single-base resolution using enzymatic conversion.

methods.name: scTEM-seq
methods.title: scTEM-seq: Single-cell analysis of transposable element methylation to link global epigenetic heterogeneity with transcriptional programs
methods.summary: Single-cell amplicon bisulfite sequencing of SINE Alu elements to estimate global methylation, paired with the transcriptome of the same cell.

methods.name: scTensor
methods.title: Uncovering hypergraphs of cell-cell interaction from single cell RNA-sequencing data
methods.summary: Detects many-to-many cell-cell interaction patterns as hypergraphs using tensor decomposition of ligand-receptor expression.

methods.name: scTF-seq
methods.title: Dissecting the impact of transcription factor dose on cell reprogramming heterogeneity using scTF-seq
methods.summary: Single-cell method that induces barcoded, doxycycline-inducible transcription factor overexpression and reads out transcriptomes to measure dose-dependent TF effects.

methods.name: scTHS-seq
methods.title: Integrative single-cell analysis of transcriptional and epigenetic states in the human adult brain
methods.summary: Transposome hypersensitive-site profiling of single nuclei, run at high throughput alongside droplet snDrop-seq.

methods.name: scTiger
methods.title: A Community-Driven Single-Cell PBMC Reference Integrating Landmark Datasets Spanning Health and Disease
methods.summary: Hierarchical label-transfer framework that projects a 192-subset PBMC annotation onto about 18 million additional PBMCs.

methods.name: scTissueID
methods.title: High resolution tissue and cell type identification via single cell transcriptomic profiling
methods.summary: Single-cell annotation pipeline that uses high-confidence reference cells to identify cell and tissue types from scRNA-seq profiles.

methods.name: scTL-seq
methods.title: Single-cell TimeLapse-seq reveals MTA is an essential retrotransposon orchestrating mouse zygotic genome activation
methods.summary: Single-cell variant of TimeLapse-seq that detects allele-resolved nascent RNA in individual mouse embryos.

methods.name: scTOP
methods.title: scTOP: physics-inspired order parameters for cellular identification and visualization
methods.summary: Physics-inspired statistical approach that scores cell identity against a reference set of cell types without feature selection or dimensionality reduction.

methods.name: sctransform
methods.title: Normalization and variance stabilization of single-cell RNA-seq data using regularized negative binomial regression
methods.summary: Regularised negative binomial regression with Pearson residuals for normalising and variance-stabilising scRNA-seq counts.

methods.name: scTrio-seq
methods.title: Single-cell triple omics sequencing reveals genetic, epigenetic, and transcriptomic heterogeneity in hepatocellular carcinomas
methods.summary: Separates each cell's RNA from its nuclear DNA so copy number, DNA methylome and transcriptome come from one cell.

methods.name: scVAR
methods.title: scVAR: integrating genomics and transcriptomics from single-cell RNA-seq -insights from leukemia case studies
methods.summary: Variational autoencoder that learns genetic variation from scRNA-seq reads and fuses it with transcriptomes to resolve cell states.

methods.name: scVelo
methods.title: Generalizing RNA velocity to transient cell states through dynamical modeling
methods.summary: Likelihood-based dynamical model of splicing kinetics that generalises RNA velocity to transient cell states.

methods.name: scVI
methods.title: Deep generative modeling for single-cell transcriptomics
methods.summary: Variational autoencoder with a zero-inflated negative binomial likelihood for normalisation, batch correction, clustering and differential expression.

methods.name: scvi-hub
methods.title: Scvi-hub: an actionable repository for model-driven single-cell analysis
methods.summary: Platform for sharing and reusing pretrained probabilistic models of single-cell omics data for query analysis.

methods.name: scvi-tools
methods.title: A Python library for probabilistic analysis of single-cell omics data
methods.summary: Python library that implements probabilistic single-cell omics models under a standardised interface linked to Scanpy, Seurat and Bioconductor.

methods.name: scvis
methods.title: Interpretable dimensionality reduction of single cell transcriptome data with deep generative models
methods.summary: Statistical model for visualising low-dimensional structure in single-cell gene expression data.

methods.name: scVIVA
methods.title: scVIVA: a probabilistic framework for representation of cells and their environments in spatial transcriptomics
methods.summary: Deep generative model that embeds cell states using both a cell's own and its neighbours' expression in spatial transcriptomics.

methods.name: scWGBS
methods.title: Single-cell DNA methylome sequencing and bioinformatic inference of epigenomic cell-state dynamics
methods.summary: FACS-sorted single-cell whole-genome bisulfite sequencing for low-coverage DNA methylation maps across many cells.

methods.name: SDevo
methods.title: State-dependent evolutionary models reveal modes of solid tumour growth
methods.summary: Bayesian state-dependent phylodynamic model that infers spatially varying division rates in tumours from the branching and mutation patterns of multi-region sequencing data.

methods.name: SDR-seq
methods.title: Functional phenotyping of genomic variants using joint multiomic single-cell DNA-RNA sequencing
methods.summary: Joint single-cell profiling of up to 480 genomic DNA loci and genes, linking variant zygosity to gene expression.

methods.name: SeaBase
methods.title: SeaBase: a multispecies transcriptomic resource and platform for gene network inference
methods.summary: Platform for sharing and searching multispecies transcriptome data and inferring gene networks.

methods.name: SEAGALL
methods.full_name: Single-cell Explainable Geometry-Aware Graph Attention Learning pipeLine
methods.title: Geometry-aware graph attention networks to explain single-cell chromatin states and gene expression with SEAGALL
methods.summary: Geometry-regularised autoencoder and explainable graph attention network that identifies which molecular features drive single-cell identity across omics data.

methods.name: Seal
methods.title: Spatiotemporal AI-based modeling of gene regulation and variant effects in the developing human brain using Seal
methods.summary: Interpretable transfer-learning model predicting gene expression and variant effects across developing human brain regions, cell types and stages.

methods.name: SEAM
methods.title: Uncovering the Mechanistic Landscape of Regulatory DNA with Deep Learning
methods.summary: Deep-learning and attribution framework that maps how mutations preserve, disrupt or create transcription-factor binding sites in regulatory DNA.

methods.name: SeAMotE
methods.title: SeAMotE: a method for high-throughput motif discovery in nucleic acid sequences.
methods.summary: Motif-discovery algorithm and web server that finds enriched motifs in high-throughput ChIP and CLIP sequence sets.

methods.name: SEC-seq
methods.title: Associating growth factor secretions and transcriptomes of single cells in nanovials using SEC-seq
methods.summary: Hydrogel nanovials capture single cells with their secreted protein, which is tagged and linked to the cell transcriptome.

methods.name: Seedability
methods.title: Seedability: optimizing alignment parameters for sensitive sequence comparison
methods.summary: Framework estimating optimal seed k-mer length and shared-seed threshold for sensitive alignment of short and divergent sequences.

methods.name: SEEK
methods.title: Targeted exploration and analysis of large cross-platform human transcriptomic compendia
methods.summary: Query-based search engine that prioritises datasets and co-regulated genes across large transcriptomic compendia.

methods.name: SeeNV
methods.title: Rapid, Reliable, and Interpretable Copy Number Variant Curation Visualizations for Diagnostic Settings with SeeNV
methods.summary: Visualisation tool for rapid, interpretable curation of copy number variants from exome data.

methods.name: SEER-Map
methods.full_name: sequential error-robust FISH spatial mapping platform
methods.title: Spatial mapping of microbial communities by an integrated automation platform of sequential FISH
methods.summary: Automated sequential FISH imaging of microbial communities that maps taxa in situ over dozens of hybridisation rounds.

methods.name: SegFinder
methods.title: SegFinder: an automated tool for identifying complete RNA virus genome segments through co-occurrence in multiple sequenced samples
methods.summary: Tool that identifies complete segments of segmented RNA viruses from metagenomic libraries by their co-occurrence at similar abundance.

methods.name: Sei
methods.title: A sequence-based global map of regulatory activity for deciphering human genetics.
methods.summary: Deep learning framework that predicts 21,907 chromatin profiles and groups sequences and variants into regulatory activity classes.

methods.name: SELECT-seq
methods.title: SELECT-seq allows Pre-Sequencing Enrichment of SNP Edits in One-Pot Single-Cell Whole-Transcriptome Sequencing
methods.summary: One-pot single-cell workflow combining SNP-specific PCR, Cas12a fluorescence detection and whole-transcriptome amplification, enriching SNP-edited cells before sequencing.

methods.name: SEMPER
methods.title: Multimodal protein representations across human brain cell types
methods.summary: Multimodal representation-learning model aligning protein language-model embeddings with protein-protein interaction networks from 442 human brain cell types.

methods.name: Seq-o-Matic
methods.title: Robust and accessible in situ sequencing with an open-source automated sequencer
methods.summary: Open-source automated in situ sequencer (fluidics, heated incubation and imaging) that runs cyclic in situ sequencing of RNA barcodes on standard microscope slides.

methods.name: Seq-Scope
methods.title: Microscopic examination of spatial transcriptome using Seq-Scope
methods.summary: Submicrometer spatial transcriptomics made by solid-phase amplification of randomly barcoded oligonucleotides on an Illumina flow cell.

methods.name: Seq-Scope-X
methods.title: Seq-Scope-eXpanded: spatial omics beyond optical resolution
methods.summary: Seq-Scope with tissue expansion for submicrometer whole-transcriptome spatial profiling, with an antibody-barcode variant for spatial proteomics.

methods.name: Seq-Well
methods.title: Seq-Well: portable, low-cost RNA sequencing of single cells at high throughput
methods.summary: Portable scRNA-seq where barcoded capture beads and single cells are sealed in subnanoliter wells under a semipermeable membrane.

methods.name: Seq-Well S3
methods.title: Second-Strand Synthesis-Based Massively Parallel scRNA-Seq Reveals Cellular States and Molecular Features of Human Inflammatory Skin Pathologies
methods.summary: Seq-Well variant that uses randomly primed second-strand synthesis to recover cDNA that failed template switching, improving per-cell fidelity.

methods.name: seq2ribo
methods.title: seq2ribo: structure-aware integration of machine learning and simulation to predict ribosome location profiles from RNA sequences
methods.summary: Hybrid simulation and machine-learning model that predicts ribosome A-site positions from mRNA sequence alone, without Ribo-seq or expression data.

methods.name: SEQC
methods.title: Single-Cell Map of Diverse Immune Phenotypes in the Breast Tumor Microenvironment
methods.summary: Preprocessing pipeline for single-cell RNA-seq data.

methods.name: SeqGL
methods.title: SeqGL Identifies Context-Dependent Binding Signals in Genome-Wide Regulatory Element Maps
methods.summary: De novo motif discovery that uses k-mer features with group-lasso regularisation to extract TF sequence signals from ChIP-, DNase- and ATAC-seq profiles.

methods.name: seqPatch
methods.title: Detecting DNA modifications from SMRT sequencing data by modeling sequence context dependence of polymerase kinetic
methods.summary: Empirical-Bayes model that borrows historical SMRT polymerase kinetics from matching sequence contexts to detect DNA modifications with less control coverage.

methods.name: seqr
methods.title: seqr: A web-based analysis and collaboration tool for rare disease genomics
methods.summary: Open-source web platform for family-based rare disease variant filtering, annotation and collaborative causal-variant identification.

methods.name: SeqTag
methods.title: The molecular asynchrony of single cells
methods.summary: Single-cell multiomics: antibody-targeted CUT&Tag (histone marks) + ATAC (accessibility) + RNA from the same cell, with plate-based combinatorial barcoding. Named in the abstract only, not the title.

methods.name: Sequencing Bead Array
methods.title: The Sequencing Bead Array (SBA), a next-generation digital suspension array
methods.summary: Digital suspension-bead assay that reads bead-captured targets by next-generation sequencing instead of optical readout, demonstrated for HPV genotyping.

methods.name: Sequencing-based neutralization assay
methods.title: High-throughput sequencing-based neutralization assay reveals how repeated vaccinations impact titers to recent human H1N1 influenza strains
methods.summary: Pools viruses carrying unique nucleotide barcodes in the HA segment and reads out each barcoded strain's infectivity by sequencing, giving neutralization titers against many strains at once.

methods.name: Sequoia
methods.title: Reconstructing phylogenetic trees from genome-wide somatic mutations in clonal samples

methods.summary: Bisulfite conversion plus whole-genome sequencing to map DNA methylation at single-base resolution.

methods.name: wglrTAPS
methods.full_name: whole-genome long-read TET-assisted pyridine borane sequencing
methods.title: Whole-genome long-read TAPS deciphers DNA methylation patterns at base resolution using PacBio SMRT sequencing technology
methods.summary: TAPS chemistry combined with PacBio SMRT sequencing for whole-genome, base-resolution 5mC and 5hmC detection on long reads.

methods.name: WhatsHap Polyphase
methods.title: Haplotype threading: accurate polyploid phasing from long reads
methods.summary: Two-stage polyploid haplotype phasing from long reads that clusters reads and threads haplotypes through the clusters, implemented in WhatsHap.

methods.name: WHdenovo
methods.title: A haplotype-aware de novo assembly of related individuals using pedigree sequence graph
methods.summary: Pedigree sequence-graph assembler that builds haplotype-resolved diploid assemblies for all members of a family from Illumina and PacBio reads.

methods.name: WheresWalker
methods.title: Phenotype to genotype: A new and rapid approach using whole-genome sequencing
methods.summary: Mapping-by-sequencing algorithm that finds the mutation-containing interval in forward-genetic screens and supports positional cloning.

methods.name: WiggleTools
methods.title: WiggleTools: parallel processing of large collections of genome-wide datasets for visualization and statistical analysis
methods.summary: Multithreaded library that computes summary statistics across large collections of genome-wide signal tracks.

methods.name: Winnowmap
methods.title: Weighted minimizer sampling improves long read mapping
methods.summary: Long-read mapper using weighted minimizer sampling that down-weights frequent k-mers to improve mapping in repetitive regions.

methods.name: WinPCA
methods.title: WinPCA: a package for windowed principal component analysis
methods.summary: Package that computes, polarises and visualises genetic principal components in windows along the genome.

methods.name: Wreath
methods.title: A framework for genome-wide characterization of DNA methylation and variant effect prediction
methods.summary: Deep-learning sequence model that predicts the context-dependent effect of genetic variants on DNA methylation, within a genome-wide methylation-class framework.

methods.name: Write-and-Read
methods.title: Write and Read: Harnessing Synthetic DNA Modifications for Nanopore Sequencing
methods.summary: Chemo-enzymatic DNA labelling with synthetic tags (e.g. glucose or azide on 5-hydroxymethylcytosine or adenine) that produces distinct, reproducible nanopore current shifts read directly from native DNA.

methods.name: X-CODE
methods.title: X-CODE: a dual RNA barcoding system for multi-platform clonal tracking and spatial phenotyping
methods.summary: Dual-expressed RNA barcode with a probe-detectable long barcode and a matched short sequencing barcode for clonal tracking across imaging, cytometry and sequencing.

methods.name: X-SPEAR
methods.title: X-SPEAR: An Extensible Framework for Spatial Panel Evaluation and Refinement
methods.summary: Framework that selects targeted spatial transcriptomics gene panels with DART Boolean gene rules trained on detection-aware reference data, plus probe-level off-target assessment.

methods.name: XChrom
methods.title: XChrom: A Cross-Cell Chromatin Accessibility Prediction Model Integrating Genomic Sequence and Cellular Context
methods.summary: Deep-learning model that predicts genome-wide chromatin accessibility in unseen cells from DNA sequence and single-cell transcriptome-derived cell identity.

methods.name: XClone
methods.title: Robust analysis of allele-specific copy number alterations from scRNA-seq data with XClone
methods.summary: Statistical method that detects haplotype-aware copy number alterations from scRNA-seq using neighbourhood and gene-graph smoothing.

methods.name: Ximmer
methods.title: Ximmer: a system for improving accuracy and consistency of CNV calling from exome data.
methods.summary: End-to-end system for evaluating, tuning and running exome CNV callers, with simulation and curation tools.

methods.name: XpBrew
methods.title: XpBrew and PanXpresso - automatic RNA-seq processing workflow and comprehensive collection of gene expression data
methods.summary: End-to-end Python workflow for automated RNA-seq processing across plants, animals, fungi, bacteria and archaea, used to build the PanXpresso collection.

methods.name: XplainTDA
methods.title: XplainTDA: Explaining the topological structure of single-cell multi-omics data through perturbation
methods.summary: Explainable topological data analysis framework that uses perturbation to identify the molecular determinants of persistent-homology structure in single-cell data.

methods.name: Xpresso
methods.title: Predicting mRNA Abundance Directly from Genomic Sequence Using Deep Convolutional Neural Networks.
methods.summary: Convolutional neural network that predicts steady-state mRNA levels from promoter sequence and mRNA-stability features.

methods.name: XPRESSyourself
methods.title: XPRESSyourself: Enhancing, standardizing, and automating ribosome profiling computational analyses yields improved insight into data.
methods.summary: Open-source toolkit that automates and standardises ribosome profiling analysis workflows.

methods.name: XR-seq
methods.title: Genome-wide analysis of human global and transcription-coupled excision repair of UV damage at single-nucleotide resolution
methods.summary: Isolates the ~30-mer excision fragments released when UV lesions are repaired and sequences them to map global and transcription-coupled repair at nucleotide resolution.

methods.name: XRBS
methods.title: Extended-representation bisulfite sequencing of gene regulatory elements in multiplexed samples and single cells
methods.summary: Reduced-representation bisulfite sequencing extended to cover regulatory elements (promoters, enhancers, CTCF sites), with barcoding before conversion for multiplexing and single-cell use.

methods.name: xseq
methods.title: Systematic analysis of somatic mutations impacting gene expression in 12 tumour types
methods.summary: Hierarchical Bayes model that quantifies the impact of somatic mutations on expression profiles, applied to TCGA tumour data sets.

methods.name: xTea
methods.title: Comprehensive identification of transposable element insertions using multiple sequencing technologies
methods.summary: Tool that identifies transposable element insertions from short-read and long-read whole-genome sequencing data.

methods.name: XYZeq
methods.title: XYZeq: Spatially resolved single-cell RNA sequencing reveals expression heterogeneity in the tumor microenvironment
methods.summary: Spatially barcoded single-cell RNA-seq workflow that encodes tissue-position metadata into scRNA-seq libraries.

methods.name: YaHS
methods.title: YaHS: yet another Hi-C scaffolding tool
methods.summary: Command-line Hi-C scaffolding tool that builds chromosome-scale scaffolds from an assembly and an alignment file.

methods.name: yeastDrop-Seq
methods.title: A yeast-optimized single-cell transcriptomics platform elucidates how mycophenolic acid and guanine alter global mRNA levels
methods.summary: Drop-seq variant optimised for yeast cells to count mRNA molecules per individual cell.

methods.name: YETI
methods.title: Interpretation of an individual functional genomics experiment guided by massive public data
methods.summary: Builds tailored functional interaction maps from public functional genomics data to interpret an individual omics experiment.

methods.name: yscRNA-seq
methods.title: Sensitive high-throughput single-cell RNA-seq reveals within-clonal transcript correlations in yeast populations
methods.summary: Strand-specific single-cell RNA-seq for yeast that counts transcript start sites, paired with index sorting to relate RNA content to cell size.

methods.name: ZCNT
methods.title: A zero-agnostic model for copy number evolution in cancer
methods.summary: Copy-number phylogeny model that allows amplification or deletion of regions with zero copies, with a closed-form distance.

methods.name: ZEN
methods.title: Zone equalisation normalisation for improved alignment of epigenetic signal
methods.summary: Normalisation that rescales genomic signal by variance within enriched regions to align replicates and samples.

methods.name: zingeR
methods.title: zingeR: unlocking RNA-seq tools for zero-inflation and single cell applications
methods.summary: Observation-weight method that makes bulk RNA-seq differential expression tools robust to zero inflation in single-cell data.

methods.name: ZipSeq
methods.title: ZipSeq: barcoding for real-time mapping of single cell transcriptomes
methods.summary: Patterned illumination prints photocaged barcodes ("zipcodes") onto live cells in tissue, linking each transcriptome to its position.

methods.name: Zman-seq
methods.title: Time-resolved single-cell transcriptomics defines immune trajectories in glioblastoma
methods.summary: Single-cell transcriptomics with time stamps written into circulating immune cells, so their state changes can be tracked in tissue over days.

methods.name: ZymoR
methods.title: ZymoR: Bridging plant pathology and automated bioinformatics for fungicide resistance profiling in Zymoseptoria tritici
methods.summary: Automated bioinformatics platform for detecting fungicide-resistance mutations and CYP51 haplotypes in Zymoseptoria tritici high-throughput sequencing data.

methods.name: μ-cisTarget
methods.title: Identification of cis-regulatory mutations generating de novo edges in personalized cancer gene regulatory networks
methods.summary: Filters, annotates and prioritises cis-regulatory mutations by their predicted effect on a personal gene regulatory network.

methods.name: μChIP-seq (Dahl 2016)
methods.title: Broad histone H3K4me3 domains in mouse oocytes modulate maternal-to-zygotic transition
methods.summary: Micro-scale ChIP-seq that profiles histone H3 lysine methylation and acetylation from very few cells, used on mouse oocytes and early embryos.
